mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tight labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 5.0%, SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of the next 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust consumer demand and labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer and labor market expansion
failure_condition: When both HOUST and PAYEMS increase by at least 0.5% month-over-month, SPX 60-day returns are negative in 60% or more of the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO above 105.0) signals robust supply chain activity and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0, SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 2.5% indicates accelerating price pressures, prompting anticipated Federal Reserve tightening, which depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong residential construction and consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month, SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of the next 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) and low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.0%) signals a strong economic expansion with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: strong economic expansion with accommodative policy
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.25% and UNRATE < 5.0%, SPX 60-day returns are negative in 60% or more of the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly retail sales figure (RSAFS) above 450,000 million dollars indicates strong consumer spending, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS exceeds 450000, SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of the next 20 trading days.
